[[The Alkali Pan]] | armorer = y | henchman = y | material trader = y | merchant = y | rare material trader = y | rune trader = y | storage = y | pic1 = [[Image:Bone Palace world map.jpg|196px]] | pic1-text = On the world map | pic2 = [[Image:Bone Palace inside.jpg|196px]] | pic2-text = A view inside | pic3 = [[File:"Badlands Bone Palace" concept art.jpg|200px]] | pic3-text = Concept art by [[Matthew Barrett]]. }} The [[Bone Palace]] is the seat of power of the [[undead]] king, [[Palawa Joko]], the Scourge of [[Vabbi]] in ancient times. {{Quotation|game| The Bone Palace... The very name strikes terror in the hearts of all Elonians. From this dark, foreboding edifice, [[Palawa Joko]] struck out across the Desolation to conquer [[Elona]]. It is said the souls of the dead enslaved by Palawa Joko still writhe within the walls, screaming for release. }} ==Getting there== Concluding the [[primary quest]] [[A Deal's a Deal]] will bring the party here. That quest is the only way to unlock access to this outpost. The doors from [[Joko's Domain]] that lead in are closed until the completion of that quest.
